replies.body:
It doesn't matter where you take the screenshot.
What matters is what he said.

What he said in your screenshot doesn't validate a warn or kick, it may warrant a verbal warn had a mod been in the game but nothing further than that.

If you have any further evidence in the future, then we can go ahead and punish, but considering this is it, it isn't enough unfortunately, so I'm going to close this report.

Thanks anyway :)
